name: Pentachlorobenzene
description: Pentachlorobenzene (CAS 608-93-5 ) is a fully chlorinated aromatic compound used industrially as a biocide and chemical intermediate. QCB is a recognized alternative name encountered in regulatory and trade documentation. Its primary function is as a preservative and antimicrobial agent in controlled industrial applications. In agricultural chemistry, it serves as a fungicide intermediate in the synthesis of active ingredients. These ingredients target soil-borne pathogens in crop protection formulations. Pharmaceutical manufacturers source it as a synthetic building block for chlorinated aromatic intermediates used in API production. It also appears in research and reference standard applications, where certified analytical grades are required for environmental monitoring and residue testing programs. Regulatory and quality laboratories use it as a calibration reference for pesticide residue analysis in food and environmental matrices. It is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline solid. It is available in technical grade for industrial synthesis and in high-purity analytical reference grades meeting certified standard specifications. Packaging is offered in small quantities and bulk formats. Bulk formats for industrial procurement are subject to applicable regulatory controls in the buyer's jurisdiction.
